ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: (1) a whole tiny old driving range seen from above: three green hitting mats in a row at the near end, a small cream hut beside them, and a long strip of rough outfield with one red flag at the far end; (2) a narrow gravel footpath with timber edging winding between two flower beds, a small lamp post beside it; (3) a wire bucket of white golf balls on a wooden counter beside an open tin cash box, a gold coin dropping into the box; (4) a folded paper map on a small table with a red-headed pin being stuck into it and a brass pointer lying beside it.
Row 2: (5) a pair of brown walking boots on a dirt footpath with a trail of footprints behind them; (6) a big red map pin standing upright on a small unfolded paper map; (7) a brass stopwatch and a wooden hourglass with sand running, on a small wooden shelf; (8) a brass magnifying glass held on a stand over a small paper map, the map enlarged in the lens.
Row 3: (9) a round wall clock on a short brick wall above a wooden rack of blank time cards; (10) a painter's wooden easel holding a small painting of a green golf hole, with a 1985 film camera on a tripod beside it; (11) a stone sundial on a lawn in bright low golden sunlight, casting a long shadow; (12) a heap of fresh brown soil with a spade stuck in it and a small yellow mini-digger bucket resting on the heap.

lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
